messages:
riley: Late night curiosity 7 what's the weirdest thing youve ever found yourself eating from the fridge at 2am? be honest.
tori: Cold pizza with a drizzle of maple syrup. dont @ me, its a vibe. :pizza::maple_leaf:
devon: Peanut butter straight from the jar with pickles on the side. salty + sweet + crunch = comfort.
chen: Warmed leftover curry over tortilla chips. zero shame.
emma: I once assembled a dessert nacho: cinnamon tortilla, cream cheese, jam. 10/10.
riley: OMG @emma thats genius. anyone do a midnight breakfast remix?
tori: Microwave buttered toast with an egg cracked on top, microwave 45s, sprinkle everything bagel seasoning. instant hangover-mitigater.
devon: @tori chef-level innovation.
chen: Confession: ive eaten cheese slices straight off the cutting board while watching a show. no crackers. primal.
emma: Also, i microwave grapes to make a warm fruit snack. weird but cozy.
snack-bot: FYI: Free granola bars in the kitchen until 6pm. (:robot_face:)
riley: We should do a "midnight snack" day where folks bring their 2am moves and we taste test. whod volunteer?
tori: 100% down. i will bring maple-drizzled cold pizza sample.
devon: I can bring peanut butter + pickle bites. maybe label them. :warning:
chen: Curry-on-chips sampler from me.
emma: Dessert nachos mini. warning: addictive.
riley: Great! snack-bot can we set a reminder for Friday 3pm in #random?
snack-bot: Reminder set: "Midnight Snack Taste Test" this Friday at 3:00pm in kitchen. :bell:
riley: Perfect. thread made my night. thanks all. :sparkles:
